offer: I was so careless as to lose my keys! There are some hobgoblins around that like to play jokes on people.

steps.text: Search for a hobgoblin snake-finder around Haggerfel and see if it has Rinda's keys.
Slay the black mauler cub that ate Rinda's key.
Return the keys and keychain to Rinda in Haggerfel.

notes: The Silver Ring of Health reward was added in 1.69; period reward is coin and xp only.

name: Sveabone Hilt Sword
offer: You do not carry one of my fine bone hilt swords! Run along and buy me a bronze short sword.

steps.text: Buy a bronze short sword from Gyda, southwest of the Jordheim bridge, and give it to Gridash.
Kill a sveawolf and return with its tooth.
Return to Gridash in Vasudheim with the tooth.

notes: Coin reward added in 1.69 (not used).

name: Trapper's Pride
offer: The famous trapper Wariel is in town from Fort Atla. Find her and learn the secrets of trapping.

steps.text: Find Wariel near the left bone crossing out of Galplen.
Capture five tawny lynx cubs in the woods and bring their pelts.
Bring the pelts to Wariel.

notes: Level range changed in 1.84; original listed 1-6 (Galplen is a level ~20 area; keep as listed).

name: Trial of Strength
offer: You have three trials to face before I can allow you to make your way in this land.

steps.text: Seek out Jorund Bruttstein in Aegirhamn and tell him your name.
Obtain proof that you have defeated a marine fungus in the waters south of Aegirhamn.
Give Jorund the marine fungus root.

name: Magnild's Cure
offer: The girl Magnild is still very ill. Go to Kari and see if she has completed the remedy.

steps.text: Speak to Kari and see if she has finished Magnild's remedy.
Give the potion to Magnild before her illness gets worse.

name: Newfound Group
offer: Seek out Kran, a good source of information in these parts and a wonderful teacher.

steps.text: Seek out Kran in Haggerfel.
Form a group with another member of Midgard and return to Kran.
Take your group into the countryside and bring back a token from a hobgoblin fish-catcher.
Return to Kran with your battle party and token.

notes: Companion bots count as a group.

name: Wealthy Prospects
offer: Bernt is a bit of an explorer and has wind of some mineral deposits. Go speak to him.

steps.text: Talk to Bernt.
Remove the stray scimitar cubs southwest past the bridge to find the mineral deposit.
Bring the mineralized rock to Bernt.

notes: In the period game the rock was clicked on the ground after killing a cub; the spec uses a drop.

name: Aegan's Letter to Helen
offer: Deliver this letter to my daughter Helen in Haggerfel.

steps.text: Deliver Aegan's letter to his daughter Helen in Haggerfel.

name: Bolli's Leather Supplies
offer: I seem to have misplaced my leather working tools. The first is a skinning knife, a present from a very old and sweet friend. Huldus come to mind; there are a bunch on a hill west of town.

steps.text: Search the hills west of Mularn for a huldu lurker with Bolli's skinning knife.
Return Bolli's skinning knife to him in Mularn.
Get the shinbone of a rattling skeleton for smoothing skins.
Bring the shinbone to Bolli.

notes: Item reward was added in 1.69 (not used).

name: Mother Dearest
offer: Nibalk, a troll and spiritual leader, is working on the Valkyn problem. The Mother has begun to enter the minds of her old followers. Go speak to Nibalk.

steps.text: Talk to Nibalk.
Kill three naive sjoras south across the bridge and bring their ears.
Return all three sjora ears to Nibalk, one at a time.

name: Trial of Bravery
offer: The last trial will prove your bravery. Go speak to Rania.

steps.text: Go to Rania in Aegirhamn.
Defeat a naive sjora and get the shell necklace it carries, along the coast south of the bridge.
Defeat a naive sjora to learn the words Rania wants.
Give Rania the sjora shell necklace.
Say the words [til sjoen] to Rania.

notes: Allakhazam's NPC is 'Raina' (dialog says Rania). Complete before training at level 5. The second trial (wits, Idena) is not in the worklist - check for it.

name: Knowledge of the Gods
offer: Inquire of each of your future guildmasters about the gods; at level 5 you will choose which god to follow.

steps.text: Ask a future guildmaster about the gods.
Ask another future guildmaster about the gods.
Return to your trainer.

notes: Same shape as Albion's Guild Preparation.

name: Rogue Trainer
offer: As a Rogue there are two houses from which you can choose: Loki and Skadi of the Great House of the Jotun.

steps.text: Find Boidoc in Fort Atla and learn of Loki and the Great House of the Jotun.
Find Budo in Fort Atla and learn of Skadi.

notes: Jucla is the Rogue trainer in Fort Atla (Allakhazam lists 'Trainer').

name: Tric's Lost List
offer: I lost my book of spells in a battle against the great goblin Gib and his followers. I am in no condition to recover it.

steps.text: Locate and slay Gib and his followers on the hill by the left fork of the main road, past the thrall keeper.
Return the book to Tric in Vasudheim.

notes: Barkeep Banak in Jordheim also points to Tric. Item reward added in 1.69 (not used).

name: Venture to Gotar
offer: Go to Fort Atla in Gotar and speak with Hyndia.

steps.text: Speak with Hyndia, the Seer trainer, in the first building on the left in Fort Atla.

name: Tomte Jerkin
offer: I have learned how to craft tomte jerkins from a few tomte bracers. Find three and return them to me.

steps.text: Get three tomte bracers from the tomte thugs in the camp in East Svealand.
Return the bracers to Gwaell in Audliten.

notes: Allakhazam also lists a Tomte Tunic (possibly a cloth-wearer version).

name: Hole of the Dead
offer: A hole in the earth sucks the life from my kind and raises them as skeletons. Bring me dust from one of the dwarven skeletons, taken while you wield the gift of your house, and I will fashion you an item.

steps.text: Slay a dwarf bone skeleton while wielding your House gift, in the depression west of the crossroads to Mularn and Audliten after nightfall.
Bring the dust to Frimeth in Vasudheim.

notes: Dwarves only. Frimeth replaces a lost house gift. Reward choice between Kelgor's Fists/Hands likely by armour type (item pass 2). The 'house gift' check can be relaxed if the server has no house gifts.

name: Simple Misgivings
offer: My ex-apprentice Quirk, a huldu, stole my plans for a new forge and headed back to the huldu camp.

steps.text: Find Quirk in the huldu camp west of Mularn (right at the fork) and get the forge plans back.
Bring the forge plans back to Hilde in Haggerfel.

name: Svartmoln's Appetite
offer: Svartmoln eat many crabs, many more fishermen. No come back until have Svartmoln hide.

steps.text: Kill Svartmoln, the bear that roams near the bridge.
Bring the hide back to Kyba in Vasudheim, next to the healer.

notes: Reward is class-specific per the walkthrough (only the light boots recorded).

name: Troubled Wild
offer: The wildling scouts lurk at the edges of civilization. Bring me three wildling ears as proof of your deeds.

steps.text: Kill three wildling scouts on the road west out of Vasudheim for their ears.
Return to Erekith in Vasudheim.

name: Brutal Chains
offer: The thralls revolted and escaped on our way to Mularn. I would not ask you to return them alive, but bring me their chains.

steps.text: Kill three escaped thralls for their chains.
Return the chains to the Thrall Keeper.

notes: The period version gave legs (removed later: 'no longer gives pants/leggings'), so the leg rewards are kept.

name: Defeat the Hobgoblin Anklebiter
offer: Smyga and Anklebiter are planning something awful! Kill Anklebiter and bring Smyga's orders to me.

steps.text: Kill hobgoblins in the camp between Mularn and Haggerfel until Anklebiter appears, and take Smyga's orders.
Take the orders back to Carr.

notes: Followed by Smyga's Raid (level 10).

name: Mucking Through the Ick
offer: I was bitten by a juvenile red-back and cannot travel. Take this note to Garon in Audliten; he has silk for me.

steps.text: Travel to Audliten and give Garon the note.
Give the silk and the scroll to Yver in Haggerfel.
Slay the plague rats that prey on the baby spiders on the wooded isle near Audliten.
Return to Yver and tell him you have [completed the task].
Travel to Gotar and seek out the ickerius spider the locals call Ick.
Return to Yver Tiu.

notes: Step 4 varied by class (Berserkers: egg sack to Darrius in Fort Atla; Thanes/Skalds/Warriors/Healers/Shamans: feed three wolf spiderlings north of Fort Veldon). Spec uses the plague rat version for all. Before 1.75 Ick lived in Gotar (moved to East Svealand in 1.75). Ending/reward truncated.

name: Sveawolf Guardian
offer: Do not be afraid; I speak directly into your mind. One of my kind has been wounded. Take up my scent and take these herbs.

steps.text: Find the wounded sveawolf behind a tree across the road from the Svartalf camp; let her smell your scent, then give her the herbs.
Return to the Elder Sveawolf on the hill southeast of Huginfell.

notes: Both sveawolves are friendly NPCs (not monsters). Barkeep Alaka points to the quest.

name: Bluebell's Disappearance
offer: My pet bird Bluebell flew off, and a nasty smiera-gatto lurks there. If she has perished, please return her remains to me.

steps.text: Slay the smiera-gatto near the trees east of Audliten and see if it killed Bluebell.
Return Bluebell's remains to Guard Eske in Audliten.
Take Eske's note to Trapper Jora in Audliten.
Give the ornamental box to Eske.

notes: Item reward added in 1.69 (not used).

name: A Deed of Old
offer: A great beast, the wolf Morra, prowls the coast. Kill it and bring me proof.

steps.text: Kill the wolf Morra up the coast near the shipwreck past the tomte camp; he runs with sveawolf mothers.
Bring the hide to Aleaniver in front of the building southwest of the Audliten bridge.

notes: Omni Hunting Gauntlets (Mid) is a later reward; not used. Class mapping from item pass 2.

name: Copious Striders
offer: My master wishes me to travel to Striders' Isle, the island behind me with the solitary rune stone, and bring back the leg of a water strider.

steps.text: Seek out and slay a water strider on the west edge of Striders' Isle.
Return the strider leg to Alomali under the tree by the water in Vasudheim.

name: Letter to Sveck
offer: Will you bring my letter to the old warrior Sveck in the fort across from Audliten?

steps.text: Deliver the letter to Sveck in the fort across from Audliten.

name: Minx Wiley
offer: Some nasty minx called Wiley keeps pestering the town and stealing stuff. Get rid of him and I'll pay ya!

steps.text: Find and kill Wiley around Huginfell.
Return to Hurg for your reward.

notes: Wiley had several spawn points around Huginfell (mostly at 5:30 game time).

name: Monstrous Beast
offer: The biggest cat I've seen in my whole life attacked my cart and ran off with my favorite book, The Yellow Canary. Fetch it and I shall reward ye handsomely.

steps.text: Find the hill cat Hrrgyf, who wanders near Darkness Falls, the Vendo caverns and Svadsad Faste, and recover the book.
Return the book to Vik by his broken cart near Mularn.
Seek out Brok in Dvalin and deliver Vik's letter.

name: Smyga's Raid
offer: Smyga plans a raid on Jordheim! Hurry and find Smyga; if he is defeated the hobgoblins have no leader.

steps.text: Kill Smyga in the hobgoblin camp where you found Anklebiter.
Return to Carr.

name: Solving the Argument
offer: Olvaerr and Ailsa won't budge until they get back their missing items. Will you help end the argument by replacing them?

steps.text: Speak with Kaisa in the small hut near Tjasse Vindrson in Dyrfjell.
Get a pelt from a mammoth calf.
Get a morvalt sinew from a morvalt ungdom.
Get some essence from a pysling.
Get an eye from a biting insect.
Return to Kaisa in Dyrfjell.
Go and see Skorri again.

notes: Tasks varied. Olvaerr and Ailsa are present NPCs beside Skorri. Reward not recorded.

name: Spat the Wild Cat
offer: Spat bit the end of Vasa's tail right off. Bring me Vasa's tail from Spat and I can make it worth your while.

steps.text: Spat is a rare spawn among the cats in the Vale of Mularn hills.
Bring Vasa's tail to Vik.

name: Tomte Problems
offer: Tomtes, tomtes, tomtes! Once they helped my family with our chores, but one day that all changed.

steps.text: Hear Thorgil's story.
Get the key from the tomte scavengers outside Thorgil's house, east over the bridge and to the south.
Search Thorgil's house for the hidden chest of jewels.
Return the chest to Thorgil in Audliten.

notes: Macalena in Haggerfel spreads the rumour. House location and reward to resolve (walkthrough stops at the chest).

name: Klippa's Claw
offer: There is a smith to the west, Lilib, who can make a special item for you. Tell him I sent you.

steps.text: Speak to Lilib in the fort before Dvalin. Tell him Alomali sent you.
Locate Klippa just east of the ant camp (kill the two crabs there until she appears) and bring Lilib the claw while fresh.
Return Klippa's claw to Lilib.

notes: Variant: kill Riv, Klippa's mate (island at 20.5k,46k), for Riva, a chain tunic.

name: Hunting Party
offer: Would you be interested in doing a little hunting for me? Let me check my scrolls.

steps.text: Hunt the dangerous creature Bork names (a savage lynx west of the healer hut, a ribbon toad, a grass viper or a grass cat) and slay it.
Return to Bork.

notes: Journal quest, repeatable; completing it three times unlocks Silent Death. The target is chosen at random from the alt list each time.

name: Ibicus
offer: A giant sea beast, Ibicus, has been ravaging the town. When you kill it, bring me its carcass and you will be well rewarded.

steps.text: Kill Ibicus near the stone bridge north of Aegirhamn, behind the boobrie hatchlings.
Return the carcass of Ibicus to Karle Alfevson, Ota Yrling or Longbeard - or give it to a Musslaklan trader and take the tokens to Gazsi.

notes: Multi-path: whoever receives the carcass gives the reward (Ota: soft lined cap, Longbeard: studded sleeves; Karle and Gazsi rewards not recorded). Nibalk and Gazsi call out to the player on the kill step. Generator: allow any of the listed NPCs as the finish target.

name: Tomte Plot
offer: Hulda's cousins are out in the wilds studying the tomtes. Speak to Hulda the shield merchant.

steps.text: Speak with Hulda the shield merchant in Audliten.
Speak with Edvard Averrson at the top of the guard tower across the bridge northeast of Audliten. Tell him [Thorgil] sent you.
Slay Edigo at the wooden tomte tower near Thorgil's farm and obtain the tomte messages.
Give Edvard the tomte messages.
Seek out the tomte Smack in his fort southeast of the road between Audliten and the rope bridge, near the drakelings.
Give Thorgil the leg bone of Smack.

notes: Step 3 varied (Ocug east up the coast, Brut at 36k,26k). Reward list not recorded (a spear option for Hunters came in 1.87).

name: Covet Wiley
offer: A thug named Olag steals our wares every night and leaves notes demanding someone called Wiley. Kill him once and for all.

steps.text: Olag has been noticed around the camp at night. Find and slay him.
Return to Aesirdia in Dvalin for your reward.

name: Thorgil's Daughter
offer: My daughter Thorhalla is gone! A note in tomte writing was left. Hulda said Emmerick would be best to help.

steps.text: Give the tomte note to Emmerick Averrson in the Dvalin guard tower, across the stone and rope bridges.
In Nisse's Lair, wearing the earring, seek out the tomte handler Nioll in the first room on the right.
Seek out the tomte captor Rygnol at the south entrance to the Executioner's room.
Kill the Executioner to save Thorhalla.
Return the tomte tooth earring to Emmerick.
Give Emmerick the Executioner's log.
Return to Thorgil in Audliten and select your reward.

notes: Only the bracelet choice is recorded (item pass 2 for the others). Rygnol was moved back to the Executioner's room in 1.63.

name: Kyllikki's Scrolls
offer: Kyllikki promised to teach me how to tap into the power of the Mother, but she won't let me read her scrolls. I will reward you well if you obtain them for me.

steps.text: Talk to Kyllikki in her house west of Catla over the bridge and tell her you seek the [scrolls of magic].
Take the scrolls to Catla in Aegirhamn.

notes: Multi-path (ask or steal while Kyllikki walks; telling Kyllikki who sent you changes the ending). Spec uses the ask path. Rewards are class-specific leggings (item pass 2).

name: Looking Ahead
offer: I know nothing of my ancestry. Go see my uncle in Mularn; take this ticket and a pint of stout.

steps.text: Speak to Greyfell's uncle in Mularn.
Kill the skogsfru Guthr at the fork in the river in West Svealand.

steps.where: cabinet beside Olav in the house north of the Audliten bindstone
steps.text: Search the cabinets in Audliten for the key.
Take the key and the chest to Greyfell in the Fort Atla tavern.

notes: The uncle's name is not recorded (resolve against Mularn NPCs or spawn). Longbeard converts the symbol to a Symbol of Longbeard's Clan (unofficial follow-up).

name: Evenings Empty Blessing
offer: There is much amiss to the north around Fort Veldon. Take this with you and seek out Kell.

steps.text: Take the bear mask to Kell, the weapon merchant in Fort Veldon.
Speak to Sydney in the guard tower near the fort.
Search for the Vendo bone-collectors in the surrounding hills and bring back what you can.
Return the ragged bear skin to Sydney.
Find Virge in Huginfell and have him translate the runes on the bear skin.
Return to Sydney with the translation.
Seek out the Vendo captain Rathis with the hunting party in the valley.

notes: A bone instead of the skin sent players to Daga in Vasudheim.

name: Lover's Circle
offer: Last winter I lost my husband, and the ring he gave me was stolen by a small sprite. Maybe you could get it for me.

steps.text: Search for Swift near the boundary gates.
Give the ring to Sugnhild in Huginfell.

name: Paranoid Guard
offer: Bork says I am seeing things, but I think a small creature is taking notes on us along the river.

steps.text: Search the river in front of the blodfelag hut and get proof of spying from the water sprite Squirt.
Give Squirt's notes to Agnor Crusher.

name: Reach of the Shadow
offer: A robed creature called Ulga leads travellers into the forest with promises of adventure and steals their life. I would start by looking in the forest where the travellers came from.

steps.text: Travel deep into the forest past the blodfelag camp and find Ulga.

name: Brack: Rollo's Story
offer: I have been wronged! Ugnof and his men stole the Brack item I was charged with and killed me. I shall not rest until someone retrieves it.

steps.text: Kill Ugnof Toestubber, who patrols around Huginfell with a blodfelag henchman and a wolfhound.
Return to Hilde in Haggerfel.
Give the word of dwarven deeds to your trainer.

notes: Dwarves only. Rollo is a dwarven ghost in the hills outside Haggerfel at night. Ugnof's drop name not fully recorded ('Brack's {something}', Hilde says keep the hammer).

name: Protect Huginfell
offer: Our spies say the Blodfelag are planning to attack. Slay their leader, Thegn Aki, at their camp down the road.

steps.text: Find the Blodfelag camp and slay Thegn Aki.

name: Tomte of Doom
offer: The tomtes are building a powerful artifact. Help me keep this from happening.

steps.text: Kill the Haunt in the spider section of Nisse's Lair.
Kill Nisse in the large room.
Use the map, then return to Yandu: the map is not complete.
Kill Hnaki in Nisse's Lair.
Kill Skirr around the Warlord's room.
Kill Callilepis Nocturna, the boss of the spider area (stealthers may slip past).
Search the area behind Callilepis Nocturna for the artifact.
Give the artifact to Yandu for your choice of rewards ([inventory]).

notes: Armour versions (cloth/leather/studded/chain) chosen by class armour type.

name: Waking of the Fallen
offer: Our Lady Eir has given me visions of a vile creature, the lich Broch, who will raise an army of the dead. Slay him.

steps.text: Kill Broch before he summons his minions, on the ridge across from the Svartalf village west of Huginfell (he walks at night).

notes: Grants no turn-in XP; the quest finishes on Broch's death. /say [find the creature] to Saydyn if stuck.

name: Protecting the Healer
offer: The svartalf have sent assassins to kill our healer! Hurry and protect Saydyn.

steps.text: Hurry and protect the healer Saydyn: talk to him, and the assassins come.
Kill the assassin Golga.
Talk to Saydyn and make sure he is alright.

name: Morana's Tunic
offer: Morana's god imbued part of her soul into a tunic, which danced away into the forest. Seek out Morana and return her spirit to her god.

steps.text: Seek out Morana to the southwest, near the hill at the base of the mountain, and return her spirit to her god.

name: The Wanestone Jewel (Gokstad's Jewel)
offer: Go find Gokstad, the troll who wanders outside the gates of Muspelheim.

steps.text: Find Gokstad outside the gates of Muspelheim. He attacks when spoken to; as he dies he speaks of a jewel eaten by Haglion's minions - one is true and two are false.
Hunt Haglion's minions, large wolves southwest of Gna Faste among the mora dancers after dark, until you find the Wanestone Jewel.
Return the jewel to Singrid in Jordheim.

notes: Pre-1.76 version (Myrkwood minions; 1.76 moved this to dark wolves in Gotar). The false drops are a fishbone necklace. Reward not recorded (item pass 2). Minion monster name to resolve on the server.

name: Fervent
offer: One of our senior elders has declared war on the two-leggers and slays any who cross her path. She must be removed.

steps.text: Find Wildtooth and her minions behind the blodfelag fort in West Svealand.
Return to the Elder Sveawolf.

name: Helping the Arachites
offer: Work with Dunfjall to improve your standing with the arachites.

steps.text: Talk with Dunfjall about the arachites.
Kill a shrieking willow on the southeast shore of the lake south of Askheim for an axe handle.
Kill a dark hound in Gotar at night for its tooth.
Return the items to Dunfjall.
Kill the svartalf sorceress Te'Delna west of the first guard tower in Myrkwood from Gotar.
Return her blood to Dunfjall.
Meet the arachite Thraxia by the skull post across the bone bridge near Nalliten (8 A.M. to 4 P.M.) and give her the axe.

notes: The Creatures of Myrkwood prerequisite must exist (check). Thraxia appears only 8-16h game time (event spawn by the skull post for the questing player in that window). Valkyrie/Warlock rewards are post-1.65.

name: Helping the Svartalfar
offer: I can create a bracer for you to improve your standing with the svartalfar.

steps.text: Kill a dark hound south of Gna Faste among the mora dancers for its fur.
Kill a great tingler north of Gna Faste for its silk.
Return the fur and silk to Dunfjall.
Kill the werewolf Fasolt at the tower outside Askheim (the Spirit of Fasolt rises after).
Take the werewolf blood back to Dunfjall.
Meet Terje at the skull-topped pole by the bridge south of Nalliten (4 P.M. to midnight).

notes: Faction choice quest (svartalf / werewolf / arachite). Terje appears at the skull pole 16-24h (the three faction NPCs rotate there). Caster mapping inferred. Alternate targets: fire ant scavenger, rabid sveawolf.

name: Helping the Werewolves
offer: The werewolves need weapons. Help me get the items to fashion a sword for them.

steps.text: Seek out the dryad blossoms in Skona Ravine for skin for the hilt.
Kill a phantom wolf in West Svealand (they appear at 10 P.M.) for its tooth for the blade.
Return the items to Dunfjall.
Find the svartalf priestess Te'Delna near the svartalf camp in Myrkwood and kill her.

notes: Alternates: frothing sveawolf fur, death spider silk, Priestess Araxia (3k,34k).

name: The Creatures of Myrkwood
offer: My friend Dunfjall is an expert at getting people to like him. If you're [up to the challenge], he can help you with the creatures of Myrkwood.

steps.text: Seek out Dunfjall hiding under the boats on the beach at Nalliten. Tell him [Atzar] sent you.
Choose which faction - werewolves, arachites or svartalfs - you would like to improve.

notes: Opens Helping the Werewolves / Arachites / Svartalfar according to the choice. Those specs list Dunfjall in Gotar; the walkthrough here puts him under the boats in Nalliten (Myrkwood) - use the server's Dunfjall spawn.

name: Living Warning
offer: Fridgeir was captured by Redhands, his tongue removed and a spell cast on him. Journey to the Blodfelag keep and release him from his fate.

steps.text: Find Fridgeir, who patrols the path beyond the blodfelag fort with a warhound and a haxa, and release him from the spell.

name: Widower Hunt
offer: There are oddities with the soot harvester spiders in Muspelheim. Please travel there and bring me their legs.

steps.text: Go to Muspelheim and slay a soot harvester.
Return the bundle of harvester legs to Yver in Haggerfel.
Take the note to Darrius in Fort Atla.
Take the spinnerets to Yver.
Travel to West Svealand and kill a blodfelag haxa.
Return the charm necklace to Yver.
Take Yver's bundle to Averrius in Gna Faste near the guard tower.
Return the enchanted spider parts to Yver.
Go to Myrkwood and slay the Widower with Yric, Yver's brother, just northwest of the Spindelhalla entrance.
Speak with Yric again.

name: Silent Death
offer: A bounty is issued for a creature terrorizing the lake at Gna Faste. Kill the beast and bring back its head.

steps.text: Travel to the lake between Gna Faste and Galplen and slay Njessi.
Return to Bork in Huginfell. Do not sell him the head.
Find Raker in Huginfell and see if the head can be crafted into anything.
Journey to Galplen and speak with Gord the smith, who will craft your weapon.

notes: Requires Hunting Party completed three times. Selling the head to Bork (+25s) ends the quest without a weapon. Rewards are no-sell (1.59).

name: Sugnhild's Revenge
offer: Please revenge my husband. Go and kill Redhands for me.

steps.text: Journey to the blodfelag fort with the moat and slay Redhands in the centre room toward the back.
Return to Sugnhild.

name: Trustan's Belongings
offer: I broke my leg falling off my horse coming up from Gna Faste. Fetch my luggage from my friend Atzar there; here is a horse ticket.

steps.text: Travel to Gna Faste and speak with Atzar on top of the guard tower. Tell him you were [sent by Trustan].
Werewolf pups robbed Atzar of Trustan's sword. Kill one west down the path behind the tower.
Give Atzar the sword.
Go to Galplen and see Curka, the merchant by the stable man, about Trustan's shield.
Out the northeast gate, past the guard tower, southwest into the woods to the valley of arachite younglings: kill one for the shield.
Kill the svartalf who took Trustan's helm, east of the Galplen direction stone near the undead area.
Return to Atzar with the shield and helm.
Ride back to Huginfell and give the pack to Trustan.

notes: Belt name not recorded ('a very nice item for piety users'). Faction-sensitive in the period game (werewolf/arachite/svartalf kills).

name: Protecting Myrkwood
offer: A staff was stolen by the svartalfar. The enchanter in the Gna Faste guard tower knows the rest of the tale.

steps.text: See the enchanter in the Gna Faste guard tower.
Kill the Tomb Priestess in the back left corner of her room in the Cursed Tomb (east of the skull pole past the bone bridge near Nalliten).
Take the top half of the staff to the enchanter in Gna Faste.
Go to the Vendo Caverns near Fort Veldon and kill Grjotgard in the second room.
Return the second half to the enchanter.
In Muspelheim, kill Haeng.
Use Haeng's scroll.
Return to Serilyna in Galplen for your reward.

notes: Rewards by base class (Mystic: hair collar, Rogue: bone collar, Seer: finger necklace, Viking: eye necklace; the Mauler necklace is post-1.65). The enchanter's name is assumed to be Bjame (related NPC); verify on the server.

name: Sulphine's Demise
offer: Kill Sulphine, a named sulphur crab in Muspelheim.

steps.text: Find Sulphine at the lava lake in the north of Muspelheim.
Return to Arnkatla in Haggerfel.

notes: Macalena in Haggerfel points to Arnkatla. Valkyrie spear reward is post-1.65.

name: Bowyer's Draw
offer: I can make you a good bow, but I need some materials.

steps.text: Get steel strand arachite silk from a great tingler near Gna Faste.
Get a perfect willow branch from a weeping willow near Gna Faste.
Bring them back to Hakon in Huginfell.
Get a digestive sac from a Muspelheim fire ant in the northwest corner of West Svealand, up the hill near the snow.
Return to Hakon.

name: Foolish Dancers
offer: Bring me what I need from Muspelheim and I can forge you a maul.

steps.text: Kill a soot harvester at the entrance to Muspelheim.
Kill a fire flower past the first pass.
Return to Cornelis the smith in Fort Veldon.
Kill the ashen spirit Olash at the large lava pit along the north wall of Muspelheim (11 P.M. to 6 A.M.).

notes: Macalena points to Cornelis. Alternate component: flask of gas from a sulphuric ghoul (night). Runemasters cannot do this quest.

name: Helping the Weaponsmith
offer: Collect some items for me and take them, with my note, to Cadbg in Hagall.

steps.text: Get a chilly skelett bone around Bjarken.
Get skalklan blood from the skalklan camps straight out from Aegirhamn.
Get morvalt landflyke hair around Bjarken.
Take the note and the three items to Cadbg in Hagall.
Return the potion to Yrling in Aegirhamn.
Yrling's swords are missing; speak with Styer.
Return to Yrling; a shale golem emissary appears. Speak with it.
Find the morvalt renegade Ghirni off the road toward the water where the coral things spawn.
Give the emissary Ghirni's head.
Give Yrling the sword and choose a weapon.

notes: Released with patch 1.60. Mauler staff is post-1.65. The emissary must not be attackable by town NPCs (event spawn for the player).

name: Stripe
offer: Long ago the Spiritmaster Varnarn tried to trick Hel and was turned into a bear the locals call Stripe. They say he carries a magical item. Find him in Skona Ravine.

steps.text: Go to Skona Ravine near the entrance to Malmohus and find Stripe.

notes: May in Huginfell gives the rumour.

name: Family Business
offer: My brother Piercer works for the svartalfs, but he's not like them. Tell him you have a message for [Halvor].

steps.text: Tell Piercer, on the ridge west of Huginfell overlooking the svartalf camp, that you have a message for [Halvor].
Find Graesen in or around the svartalf camp and see if he will release Piercer from his svartalf obligations.
Find Graesen's agent in Myrkwood, disguised as an arachite priest, and tell him [Graesen sent me]. He will probably attack.
Graesen tried to trick you. Tell Piercer of Graesen's trickery.
Find and kill Rip southwest of the main svartalf camp in West Svealand.
Talk to Piercer.
Kill Priest Thaxtix on the west shore of the lake north of the werewolf fort.
Return Priest Thaxtix's leg to Piercer.

notes: Alternate branch: report to Graesen instead (also leads to Rip). The arachite agent can be any arachite priest/weblasher/shadowslinker/great tingler in the period game.

name: Nimh's Secret
offer: Kill Nimh, a rat in Skona Ravine.

steps.text: Search for Nimh among the wood rats along the north wall of Skona Ravine, past the werewolf skulkers.

name: Better Off Buried
offer: Learn the tale of the book av den dode, the tome of runes Redhands used to curse Huginfell.

steps.text: Learn the tale of the book av den dode from Gudlor in Huginfell.
Visit Agnor Crusher in the northwest corner of Huginfell and get the ring av den dode.
Journey to Uppland, wear the ring and slay a boreal cockatrice on the road from Svasud Faste.
Return to Agnor Crusher and learn how the book may be destroyed.
Find the small boulder on the ridge north of the blodfelag camp by the lake.
Wait there until midnight, wear the ring and use the book.
Return the book to Gudlor so he may protect it.
Journey to the island of fire just east of the Muspelheim entrance and slay the twisted blodfelag king Strykel.

notes: Formerly the Strykel one time drop. The ring has -30 STR and -200 hits while worn. Uppland target varied.

name: Lost Maps
offer: Someone stole two of Longbeard's maps while I slept - Grenlock clan, I think. Go to Keirstyn Alfevson.

steps.text: Seek out Keirstyn Alfevson and tell her [Sinna Redtoes] sent you.
Travel to Knarr and ask Heikki, by the stablemaster, about [Modolf].
Past the shalklan settlement where the mist menaces roam, the drowned walk at night. Find Modolf's spirit inland from the shore and take the map.
Read the writing on the back of the map.

steps.whisper: Modolf drowned and I got the map
steps.text: Travel to Bjarken and tell Merja that [Modolf drowned and I got the map].
Retrieve Idette's half of the map.
Retrieve Loden's half of the map.
Return to Merja with both halves.
Return to Sinna Redtoes in Aegirhamn with the maps.

notes: Ending and reward cut off (step 12+). Whether Idette and Loden are fought or talked to is not recorded (spec kills them). Modolf also dropped axes.

name: Furf's Reward
offer: A cat in Skona Ravine hissed at my group and slashed one of us. To this day I wish we had taught that cat a lesson.

steps.text: Look for Furf on the raised sand bar in the centre of Skona Ravine near the werewolves' main camp and slay him.

name: Ota's Quest
offer: I want a griffon pelt. Bring this bag of trade goods to a bergklan pelterer first; make sure you are on neutral terms with them.

steps.text: Bring the bag of trade items to a bergklan pelterer in the Gripklosa Mountains.
Return the pelt to Ota.
Hunt the Gripklosa Mountains for a griffon loner (SSE of Bjarken by the mylings). If the griffon inquires, speak of [Ota], then [bargain].
Find a hrimthursa brute in the northwest of Delling Crater and kill it.
Take the giant nose back to the griffon loner.
Tell Ota the [griffon has many more] and give her the kobold skin.

notes: The kill branch (kill the loner for a claw and pelt) also existed; the bargain branch is specced. The griffon loner must be talkable while normally a monster (quest NPC behaviour). Berserker/Healer/Spiritmaster/Shadowblade rewards not recorded; Valkyrie/Warlock post-1.65.

name: Tale of Two Trolls
offer: I sold an old book about the werewolves and a magical crown to two trolls; they tore it in half fighting over it. If you can get the book back, a strange woman is searching for it.

steps.text: Journey to Galplen and seek out Aki, the troll merchant, for the first half of the book.
Aki will trade his half for a perfect badger pelt from a woodland badger in Skona Ravine.
Give Aki the pelt.
Kedin, the troll merchant in Gna Faste, wants oil from a giant tree frog near the standing stones in Skona Ravine.
Give Kedin the oil.
Give the halves to the mysterious woman Alina on the shore east of Askheim.
Confront Alina after sunset, when she wanders as a werewolf.
Kill Baron Falwur in the werewolf fort of Askheim and take the crown.

notes: Alina is a day NPC who despawns about 20h and walks as Noble Werewolf Alina at night. Savage mapped to Spiked (not listed).

name: Young Fire Wyrm Lord
offer: A young fire wyrm lord, larger than any beast I've seen, slaughtered my old group in Muspelheim. If you're brave of heart, destroy him.

steps.text: Go to Muspelheim, follow the wall left around to the wyrms, and destroy the young wyrm lord.

name: Krrrck's Torment
offer: Krrrck was once a priest of Skadi, turned into a frog by Loki. Find him in Skona Ravine and release his soul.

steps.text: Seek out Krrrck south and west of the circle of stones in Skona Ravine, slay him and release his soul.

notes: Minimum level 32 and Bonedancers came with 1.76; the period minimum was lower (unknown) - keep 32 per Allakhazam? Prefer a lower start (25) as the pre-1.76 value if the owner asks.

name: Juuso's Potion
offer: Catla has ordered me to make a potion that lets her use the power of the Mother. Help me get what we need, starting with my friend Edrigu.

steps.text: Obtain a wiggly tentacle from an ingester on the northern end of the island east of Knarr.
Use the amulet to complete it, then put it on. Do not attack any skalklan while wearing it.
Wearing the amulet, tell the skalklan Edrigu that [Juuso sent] you for the ingredient.
Give Juuso the skin of fluid.
Hunt a woolly mammoth east of Bjarken for its fur.
Fill a vial with the blood of a morvalt streber.
Fill the other vial with the blood of a morvalt vandarare.
Return to Juuso in Dyrfjall to complete the potion.

notes: Ending and reward not captured (item pass 2). Edrigu turned hostile after handing over the fluid.

name: Lord Lauur's Wife
offer: Lord Lauur is upset: his wife's spirit is held by the svartalfar and the arachites. Go talk to him (he walks only between midnight and 8 A.M.).

steps.text: Talk to Lord Lauur.
Talk to Hyua, the troll hiding behind a tree behind the Gna Faste merchants; she tries to kill you. Kill her instead.
Read the diary to learn where Lene's spirit is held.
Kill Te'Bui in Spindelhalla for the white spirit crystal.
Use the crystal to find the next one.
Kill an arachite tunnelhost for the black crystal.
Take both crystals to Lord Lauur so he can restore his wife's spirit.

notes: Werewolf faction follow-up. Allakhazam lists the same cloak rewards as Thraxia's Dilemma (possibly a copy-paste on their side; keep until item pass 2).

name: Thraxia's Dilemma
offer: Thraxia needs help: one of her priests is held captive. Go talk to her.

steps.text: Talk to Thraxia by the skull post (8 A.M. to 4 P.M.).
Find out where the priest is held: search the huts in Skona Ravine for a parchment.
Read the parchment.
Kill the svartalf Te'Bui in Spindelhalla, who possesses the spirit.
Use the totem to release the spirit.
Kill Thelod in Varulvhamn to free the priest.
Return to Thraxia.

notes: Fressen is the kobold on the shipwreck on the beach next to Trolki. The finish NPC is assumed to be Thraxia.

name: Zrit-Zrit's Item
offer: Kill Zrit-Zrit, a timberland badger in Skona Ravine, and find the item of the warrior it devoured.

steps.text: Kill Zrit-Zrit northeast of the Sidhe Draoi camp in Skona Ravine.

name: Mother's Children
offer: Kill three skadedjur and bring back their remains, then investigate the strange sjoalfs to the north.

steps.text: Kill three skadedjur.
Bring the remains back to Shiake.
Investigate the strange sjoalfs north of Shiake.
Return to Shiake.

notes: Other classes' rewards not recorded (item pass 2).

name: Black Plague (Mid)
offer: A sickness spreads. Speak with Arve the enchanter in the round hut by the Mularn entrance.

steps.text: Go see Arve, the enchanter in the round hut by the Mularn entrance.
Talk to Ottar, the merchant next to Arve.
Give the letter to Thora in the building left of the Huginfell inn.
Return to Ottar and hand him Thora's letter.
Speak with Arve again.
Go back to Nanna.
Kill Lecherous Gress above the Rocot rooms in Darkness Falls.
Take the stoppered wondrous potion back to Nanna.

notes: Thora offers 2 gold for travel. Variant: a gelid mass in Uppland before Darkness Falls.

name: Morvalt Crystal
offer: Retrieve the Morvalt crystal. Find Kreg, a bergklan concoctor in the Gripklosa Mountains, and get his map.

steps.text: Find Kreg, a bergklan concoctor, and ask him for the [map].
Follow the map to the morvalt camp and kill the morvalts there to learn the words.
Run up to the fire by the crystal bearer and say the words [Rosa Er Kraft].
Return the crystal to Kekov in Hagall.

notes: The morvalt kill target name to resolve (morvalt camp near the crystal bearer). Kreg gave the map freely at friendly faction.

name: Gazsi's Nightmares
offer: Gazsi is plagued by nightmares. Gather what I need for the ritual powders.

steps.text: Kill a mammoth herdguard for its fur.
Kill a yellowed skeleton in Delling Crater for a bone.
Kill a sulphurous cloud in Delling Crater for sulphur.
Return to Luikko in Hagall with the three items.
Kill Urtzi in Munin Sound, west-southwest of Hagall along the zone wall to the shore.
Drop the black powder where the ritual stone glows black.
Drop the white powder at its glowing stone.
Drop the gray powder at its glowing stone.
Drop the brown powder at its glowing stone.
Return to Luikko in Hagall for your reward.

notes: Other classes' rewards from item pass 2 (Sulphur Encrusted Sleeves, Yellowed Bone Sleeves also listed).

name: Cargila's Blessing
offer: Discover the secret of Cargila's nine thousand lives. Cargila is a timber cat in Skona Ravine.

steps.text: Look for the rare timber cat Cargila near the entrance to Varulvhamn.
Return to Geiri in Nalliten and tell him of the [magical boots].

name: Werewolf Bane
offer: Head to Gna Faste and speak with Averrius about the werewolves.

steps.text: Speak with Averrius on the top level of the hut in Gna Faste.
Retrieve a werewolf direction sense charm from a wolfaur headsman in the first hut in the ravine before the bridge.
Give Averrius the charm.
Kill the three werewolf lords in the new area of Varulvhamn and take their essences.
Take each essence to the altar and use it to turn it into a gem.
Return the three gems to Averrius.
The arrow merchant outside says the belladonna comes from a mud crab warrior in Vanern Swamp.
Bring the belladonna to Averrius and choose your weapon.
Kill the werewolf king Hresveigr in his regal chamber in Varulvhamn.

notes: Lord names to resolve on the server (one is the high lord Moldolfr). Reward names truncated ('Varulbane T...'); item pass 2. The weapon is given at the choice step; the king kill finishes the quest.

name: Gem of the Dwarven King
offer: Talk to Ornulf in Delling Crater about the lost gem of the dwarven king.

steps.text: Find Ornulf by a rock just outside Dellingstad.
Read the note.
Kill the golem Smastein.
Kill the golem Klippe.
Kill the golem Kampestein.
In the caldera, jump into the steam vent and move about until you find the box.

steps.gives: Lost Gem of the Dwarven King
steps.text: Use the three keys to unlock the box.

steps.item: Lost Gem of the Dwarven King
steps.text: Return to Abjorn Onefoot in Hagall with the gem and pick your reward.

notes: Longbeard's Necklace (recall to Hagall) is usable only in the box area (1.63). Ornulf is talked to if not KOS (kill otherwise); spec kills.

name: Price of Excellence
offer: Seek out the Lady of Loki, Gythja of Loki, in the temple.

steps.text: Speak with Gythja of Loki in the temple and ask about Ulfgar.
Bring her leather and metal (not cheap metals) bought from the merchants nearby, so she can bless them.
Take the blessed materials to the smith (Audliten or Huginfell) to craft an amulet.
Give the amulet to the follower of Loki on the island north of Huginfell.
Find Ulfgar, a named fenris tracker northwest of Midgard's relic keep in Yggdra Forest.

notes: Material item names are not recorded; Loki may reject the offering (repeat).

name: Hidden Maps
offer: I need five map pieces from the hrimthursa warriors and a key.

steps.text: Kill hrimthursa warriors carrying a spear, hammer, axe, sword and two-handed sword for the five map pieces.
Return the five map pieces to Sisko in Bjarken.
Kill a griffon frostwing for its eye.
Give Sisko the eye.

name: Mammoth Hunt
offer: Hunt the mammoth bulls and matriarchs in Mammoth Valley and bring me their tusks and pelts.

steps.text: Hunt mammoth bulls and matriarchs in Mammoth Valley for five tusks.
And three pelts.
Return the tusks and pelts to Bothrar Hadd in Bjarken.
Volkstad in Dellingstad sends you to wipe out the morvalt mammut jagare camp above Mammoth Valley.
Kill a mammoth matriarch or bull once more for a whisker.
Return the whisker in Dellingstad.

notes: Incomplete walkthrough (Allakhazam says so): NPCs Volkstad/Vorkald in Dellingstad, step order partly reconstructed. Many class rewards listed (Gory/Jeweled Mammoth Eye, Tusk Blade, Tusked Handled Battlehammer, Thick Mammoth Fur Cloak, Mammoth Boned Boots, Charmed/Warding String Ring, Mammoth Boned Hammer, Boned Ivory Staff, Tusk Bladed Fist) - class mapping from item pass 2.

name: Strange Bedfellows (Mid)
offer: Speak with a new imp named Mystemas in Darkness Falls.

steps.text: Speak with the imp Mystemas at the Midgard entrance of Darkness Falls.
Kill the svartalf dark forester in the northeast corner of Malmohus (he walks with eight svartalf infiltrators).
Return to Mystemas.
Kill Princess Nahemah.
Kill Ambassador Mannam.
Return the soul stone to Mystemas.

notes: Black Plague -> Strange Bedfellows -> Breaking the Blade chain (consecutive Allakhazam ids 1800-1802, Sept 2003 = patch 1.65 era). Midgard version also mentions a shade and the fallen spirit of a dead healer (not placed).

name: The Legend of Fenrir's Folly
offer: The winning tale of the 2002 Herald quest contest. Seek Londar at the top of the tower across the road from Haggerfel.

steps.text: Speak with Londar at the top of the tower across the road from Haggerfel.
Seek the fire giants in Muspelheim and learn what you can from them.
Tell Londar of the [dream].
Kill svards in the small house at the blodfelag fort for a worn journal.
Read the journal.
Kill werewolf guards outside Varulvhamn by the west Skona stables for a dwarf skin scroll.
Read the scroll.
Tell Londar the fragment is in [Raumarik].
Find Gris in the smithy behind the tavern by the north gate of Jordheim and tell him [Londar] sent you.
Get the scales of a great brown drake in the Pennine Mountains northwest of Caer Sursbrooke.
Get the teeth of a parthelonian wizard in Breifine.
Return to Gris with the scales and the teeth.
Tell Londar you [have the casket].
Talk to Drav by the tavern entrance in Galplen.
Kill the Raumarik Revenant in the undead fortress in Raumarik.
Return to Drav.

notes: Pennine Mountains and Breifine are enemy frontier zones (region 1 / 200).

name: Breaking the Blade (Mid)
offer: Prince Abdin's plans must be broken.

steps.text: Kill Director Kobil.
Return to Mystemas.
Kill Prince Abdin.
Return to Mystemas for a belt.
Mystemas sends you to kill Legion.
Return to Mystemas for another reward.

notes: The period step 'talk to the Albion and Hibernia Mystemas and get their lifestones' needs enemy-realm DF entrances; the generator lets the player skip it (Legion is shared). Legion and Prince Abdin are raid bosses: player quest kills count when the player is in the raid or group that kills them.

name: Balle's Potion
offer: Sub-quest of Dark Places of the Soul: gather the ingredients for my brew.

steps.text: Find the green orms in Skona Ravine and kill one for its bile.
Find the forest vipers in Vanern Swamp and kill one for venom.
Find the large enslaved orms and kill one for a teardrop.
Give Balle the list, the bile, the venom and the teardrop, in that order.

notes: Merged into Dark Places of the Soul by the generator (step 19).

name: Strange Powers
offer: Sub-quest of Dark Places of the Soul.

steps.text: Find Goi Halfdan upstairs in the house behind the stone wall in Mularn and hand her the sack.
Speak with Garon in the first house southwest of the Audliten drop-off.
Seek out Eresidae on a ridge southeast of Dun Crauchon in Emain Macha.
Hand Garon Eresidae's carcass.
Give Goi Goran's antidote.
Hand Yver Tiu the enchanter antidote.

notes: Emain Macha is Hibernia's frontier (region 200).

name: Dark Places of the Soul
offer: Something stirs in the dark places of the soul. Find Jytal in Gna Faste and say my name.

steps.text: Find Jytal in the Gna Faste hut and say [Idona].
Ride to west Skona, head east, and watch the arachites go into the building with the werewolves.
Tell Jytal whether the arachites were [defeated] or [victorious].
Kill the svartalf Gunflor in the building on the little island with the well east of Gna Faste.
Hand Gunflor's head to Jytal.
Talk with Idona in Fort Veldon again.
Go to Haggerfel and complete Yver Tiu's Strange Powers.
Tell Idona [Yver is cured].
Find Blackpaw in the northeast corner of Jordheim.
Tell Idona [the werewolves have allied].
Speak with Goi in Mularn.
Tell Besje in Huginfell [stone bowl].
Ask Alfgeirr by the Jordheim forge about the [magical bowl].

steps.where: northeast of Glenlock Faste, between the stones
steps.text: Find the cold stone between the stones northeast of Glenlock Faste.
Take the stone back to Alfgeirr.
Take the bowl to Besje in Huginfell.
Take the bowl to Goi in Mularn.
Find Balle in Uppland and brew his potion.
Find Grumblebelly around Galplen and say [dark magic] to make Errick appear.
Return to Idona and say [Errick lives].
Find Yver in Skona Ravine.

notes: About four hours long; Midgard only (1.65). The finale after Yver in Skona is not recorded (frost spectre fight likely - related NPC Frost Spectre). The Herbalist's Hauberk is chain; other classes' versions unknown.

name: Catla's Downfall
offer: I have come to help stop Catla Gardasdottir's mad plans.

steps.text: Travel to Aegirhamn and talk to Catla.
Read Catla's note.
Get a large spore from a cadby in Iarnvidiur's Lair.
Obtain some hairs from the head of a redcap davin.
Take the items to Juuso in Dyrfjell.

spawn.where: westernmost of the three large boulders outside Dyrfjell's wall

steps.text: Seek out Catla's spirit on the westernmost of three large boulders outside Dyrfjell and give her the potion.
Give Medana the stone and choose two bracers.

notes: Two of eleven bracers (names mostly unrecorded; Valkyrie/Mauler ones are post-1.65). Third Iarnvidiur item cut off in the note text.

name: Final Rest
offer: The dead of this land find no rest. Kill what I ask.

steps.text: Kill a spectral snake.
Kill a spectral feline.
Kill a corrupted howler.
Kill the morvalt Basilus in the camp in the northeast corner (he brings friends).
Return to Shiake for your reward.

name: Stoneheart
offer: A rejected dwarf's tale leads to the depths of Trollheim and the ancient Stoneheart.

steps.text: Find Damekia in the Gripklosa Mountains (daytime).
Kill a lone saber-toothed cat east of Dellingstad.
Kill a redcap herbalist at Iss on the north wall of the Gripklosa Mountains.
Return to Damekia; she gives you the runed cloak of the trolls. Wear it for the rest of the quest.
Fight your way into Trollheim, up the undead morvalt valley, across the bridge room to the spiral ramp, and find Darac.
Kill Dagar (two groups advised).
Return to Jago in Dyrfjell and choose your weapon.

notes: Walkthrough is fragmentary (steps 3-7 missing); order and some item names reconstructed - needs research before generation.

name: Barkley One Time Drop
notes: Hillside east of the camp, under a tree.

name: Twitchclaw One Time Drop
notes: Wanders near the carrion crawlers toward Myrkwood.

name: Tas One Time Drop
notes: Named lynx southeast of the bone bridge past Nalliten.

name: Trolki One Time Drop
notes: On the shipwreck on the beach between Nalliten and Fort Atla, with Fressen.

name: Vidalf One Time Drop
notes: Named host of the wind near the host of the earth spawn; circles the lake with Vefyn.

name: Birk One Time Drop
notes: Named hobyah on the hobyah island; spawns at night after the centre hobyah dies. Sleeve name not recorded.

name: Salix One Time Drop
notes: Named weeping willow north of Gna Faste.

name: Great Worg One Time Drop
notes: Southwest of Gna Faste on the trail to the werewolf fortress, with two escorts.

name: Chaes One Time Drop
notes: By the fire in the svartalf camp (shares the spot with Golga and Kelda).

name: Kelda One Time Drop
notes: By the fire in the svartalf camp near Piercer. Studded in the period (leather later).

name: Old Smoke One Time Drop
notes: Svartalf tent camp beside the blodfelag plateau camp near Huginfell. A hits version also listed.

name: Pawper One Time Drop
notes: North of the main blodfelag fort along the mountains.

notes: Lake west of Gna Faste at the Myrkwood/Skona point.

notes: With the phantom wolves at night.

notes: Rare spawn among the regular sentries.

notes: Named fire flower at the fire flower camp east of the lava pit, with two other flowers; roams.

notes: Named entrancing dirge on the hill past the tower on the left entering Myrkwood from Gotar.

name: Brimstone One Time Drop
notes: Named ghoul south of the entrance past the first bridge, at night.

name: Brimstone Breastplate Time Drop
notes: Plate/chain wearers (a healer did not get it).

notes: Named fire giant just inside the gates.

notes: Walks from the dverge island with a dverge igniter and a noxious hound to Gunnar's skeletons.

notes: Named fire cat near the fire giant lookouts; slow spawn.

notes: Ultra rare near the ashmongers.

notes: Named werewolf near the werewolf skulkers.

notes: Named tree spirit (already planned as a spawn in spawn_plan via anchors).

notes: Near the cinder drakes; roams toward the gate and lake.

notes: Named flaming raukomaz in a lava pit near the crooked bridge; brings a friend.

notes: Named wind spirit near the two empty huts / Furf's ditch.

Thasior One Time Drop
notes: Rare named werewolf warder in the forest near the Varulvhamn cave (journal calls it Thasia).

notes: Named elder skogsfru in the southwest corner near Vanern Swamp. Reward name not recorded (item pass 2).

notes: Same monster as the Albion entry A245 (enemy frontier for Midgard).

notes: Chain wearers only (Healer, Shaman, Warrior reported).

notes: Near a camp of ghostly invaders (only New Frontiers locs recorded; place at the classic Yggdra ghostly invader camp). Axe users.
